title: Failed to pull data from the cloud
symptom: dvc pull reports 'ERROR: failed to pull data from the cloud' or a missing cache warning.
guidance: DVC documents that a common cause is pushing Git changes without pushing the corresponding data to the DVC remote. From the source project, run dvc push, then retry dvc pull. Treat this as a likely cause, not a confirmed diagnosis.

title: Check which remote dvc pull uses
symptom: dvc pull cannot find tracked objects in the expected remote, or uses a different remote than intended.
guidance: DVC selects a remote from the remote fields in dvc.yaml or .dvc files first, then the --remote argument, then core.remote. Check the selected name and use dvc remote list to inspect configured remotes.

title: Configure and authenticate a DVC remote
symptom: DVC cannot connect to or authenticate with its configured remote storage.
guidance: DVC remotes are configured in the project configuration. Verify the remote URL and provider credentials. Keep sensitive remote settings in the local, Git-ignored config rather than committing credentials.
